counties. The fog was locally dense in spots, as the Sturgeon Bay
Airport recorded a visibility of 1/4 mile.

rapidly changing or poor visibilities as low as 1/4 mile or less
in spots. Plan on extra time to reach your destination and allow
extra room between you and the car in front of you.

shift to the northwest and increase.

Consider temporarily moving outdoor potted plants indoors if they are
sensitive to cold temperatures.

Consider temporarily covering sensitive plants with a lightweight
cotton fabric (i.e., bedsheets, thin blankets), as this will help
retain heat and provide frost protection for your plants.

properties.areaDesc: Kosrae Coastal Waters
properties.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued October 13 at 3:29PM ChST until October 15 at 3:00PM ChST by NWS Tiyan GU
properties.description:
* WHAT...West winds 15 to 25 kt with gusts to around 30 kt and
seas 6 to 9 feet.

* WHERE...Kosrae Coastal Waters.

* WHEN...Until 3 PM ChST Thursday.

* IMPACTS...Conditions will be hazardous to small craft.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Latest scatterometry pass that was just
east of Kosrae showed sustained winds around 20 knots with a
pocket of locally higher winds, indicating these winds are likely
also impacting the coastal waters of Kosrae.
properties.instruction:
Inexperienced mariners, especially those operating smaller
vessels, should avoid boating in hazardous conditions.
